subject: cli/semantic-exit-code-documentation
statement: Agent DevTools must document semantic exit-code classes: rc=0 is successful/clean action, rc=1 may be an expected actionable gate or non-clean review state such as cognition checkpoint requiring promotion, and rc=2 represents invalid invocation or execution-contract failure.

sourceSession.taskGoal: Implement R6.4 Context Recall & CLI Friction from 0.15.3 dogfood: bounded possibly-related durable cues, compact cognition output, research help discoverability, and semantic exit-code documentation.
